name: How long do aging-in-place renovation projects take?

mainEntity.name: How long do aging-in-place renovation projects take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of aging-in-place renovation projects depends on their scope. Small projects, like installing grab bars or updating lighting, might take a few days. Bathroom remodels with curbless showers and accessibility features typically range from 2 to 4 weeks. More extensive whole-home renovations involving multiple rooms can take several weeks to a few months. We establish a clear timeline at the project's outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; small updates can take days, while comprehensive bathroom or whole-home renovations may last several weeks to a few months.
